summary: Repository-only, DARK/default-OFF implementation of the bridge-boundary lifecycle guard (ADR-0084): a pure, importable pre-state / revision / deadline / idempotency admission + explicit-outcome classifier for copier follower MODIFY/PARTIAL_CLOSE/FULL_CLOSE, realising the ADR-0083 bridge-enforcement prerequisite. NO migration, no bridge wiring in this packet (the live money path is byte-identical), no production change, no broker order, no credential handled, no flag armed.
phase1_gap_audit: Traced the real path assumption-free. The backend already carries every needed field (ADR-0083 _live_command_envelope: pre-state fingerprint, master_revision, deadline, idempotency key, correlation id) AND reconciles a partial close read-only (PCLOSE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, never a blind retry). The no-late-entry policy is enforced by the pure lifecycle engine. The GAP is at the final bridge boundary: the bridge (scripts/mt5_signal_bridge.py) enforces the identity pin but NOT the pre-state fingerprint / lifecycle revision / deadline, and maps outcomes to success/failure, not the explicit set. Full matrix in ADR-0084.

delivery_state: PR_READY — repository-only, DARK/default-OFF, auto-merge OFF, STOP before merge. The live bridge money path is UNCHANGED in this packet (the guard is not yet wired — a deliberately separate, focused PR).
open_modify_close_behaviour: OPEN: unchanged (live OPEN admitted by ADR-0057; no-late-entry by the pure engine).

MODIFY SL/TP (add/change/remove, from neither/SL-only/TP-only/both): admit_mutation verifies pre-state + revision + deadline + identity + symbol; idempotent (ALREADY_APPLIED when SL/TP already set); normalised price compare; never an older revision over a newer; broker rejection truthfully classified; no repeat of a broker-invalid modify (the guard rejects/contains, it does not loop).

PARTIAL CLOSE: proportional reduction verified strictly-reducing against the fresh follower volume (pre-state fingerprint); idempotent (ALREADY_APPLIED when already at expected_remaining); volume-step tolerance; a partial that leaves no position is CONTAINED (never 'applied').
FULL CLOSE: idempotent (absent position -> ALREADY_APPLIED); APPLIED only when the post-snapshot confirms the position is gone.
All via the pure guard; NO path opens or increases exposure; NO path turns an uncertain result into success.
no_late_entry_recovery_proof: The guard never opens a position (only MODIFY/PARTIAL/FULL on an existing LINKED ticket). No-late-entry remains enforced by the pure lifecycle engine (ENTRY_FAILED_FINAL absorbs all later events; proven by the merged trade_copier.tests_lifecycle + tests_live_lifecycle). A mutation past its deadline is DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (never a late action).
pre_state_deadline_idempotency_proof: admit_mutation: PRE_STATE_MISMATCH on ticket/login/server/symbol/volume mismatch; DEADLINE_EXCEEDED on now>=deadline and CONTAINED on a missing/unparseable deadline; STALE_REVISION on revision<=last_applied; POSITION_NOT_FOUND on an absent modify/partial target; ALREADY_APPLIED on an already-holding post-state. classify_result: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME on indeterminate/no-post-snapshot (never success); BROKER_REJECTED on definitive refusal; CONTAINED_FAILURE on a determinate success whose post-state contradicts the request. Proven by the 29-case suite.
unknown_outcome_reconciliation_design: classify_result returns UNKNOWN_OUTCOME (never success) for a timeout/lost-connection/missing-post-snapshot; the bridge (once wired) reports it, and reconciliation is a READ (not a blind retry): the partial-close reconcile (reconcile.reconcile_partial_close / PCLOSE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, read-only) is the existing pattern; the modify/full-close reconciliation extension + the backend outcome recording are the documented next step (ADR-0084 integration points). No unbounded/exponential/restart-driven retry is introduced.
operator_alert_view_coverage: The guard's explicit outcomes (PRE_STATE_MISMATCH / DEADLINE_EXCEEDED / UNKNOWN_OUTCOME / CONTAINED_FAILURE / ...) are the SAME vocabulary the merged ADR-0083 Phase-3 operator alert classifier (classify_lifecycle_failure, PR #625) already maps, so once the bridge reports them the operator alert + read-only view surface them with no new category work.

adversarial_review.method: One independent adversarial subagent lane on the pure guard logic, reproducing every finding against the real module.

findings.title: Non-finite floats (NaN/Inf) passed _num, defeating the deadline AND partial-reduction gates (fail-OPEN: admitted the send).
findings.fix: _num now rejects non-finite (math.isfinite) and bools; a NaN/Inf deadline -> CONTAINED, a NaN volume -> never PROCEED. Regressions: test_nan_deadline_fails_closed, test_nan_volume_not_proceed.

findings.title: OP_MODIFY never required a numeric SL/TP target -> a degenerate empty command PROCEEDed (stripping protection) or returned a false ALREADY_APPLIED (silent skip of a real modify).
findings.fix: the MODIFY branch fails closed (CONTAINED_FAILURE 'modify_missing_targets') when neither target is numeric. Regression: test_modify_empty_post_state_fails_closed.

findings.title: A tz-less ISO deadline was interpreted in host-local time (extending the deadline on a non-UTC host).
findings.fix: _deadline_epoch treats a naive datetime as UTC. Regression: test_naive_iso_deadline_is_utc.

findings.title: A non-integer/garbage master_revision (or last_applied_revision=None) raised out of the guard instead of a terminal outcome.
findings.fix: _int_or_none coercion; a bad revision -> CONTAINED_FAILURE 'command_bad_revision'; last_applied None -> -1. Regressions: test_non_integer_revision_fails_closed, test_last_applied_none_does_not_raise.

findings.title: The identity/symbol fingerprint was soft/opt-in (identity only when require_identity_pin; server/symbol only when present).
findings.fix: identity pin + login + server + symbol are now MANDATORY for a copier mutation (a command missing any -> CONTAINED_FAILURE); the login/server/symbol checks are unconditional. Regression: test_missing_identity_or_symbol_fails_closed.

invariants_confirmed_holding: Uncertain never success (classify_result UNKNOWN_OUTCOME before any APPLIED); partial strictly-reducing against the follower snapshot; stale-revision equal-is-stale with no off-by-one; price-unset (0.0/None) semantics correct; position-presence robust to None/{}/{'exists':False}.
adversarial_review.result: 2 HIGH + 2 MEDIUM + 1 LOW fixed with mutation-killing regression tests; guard suite re-run green at 36 tests.
